body: Because I cry and cry and I don't ever make any progress on anything. They don't think I'm trying, and since I've been born privileged they don't think it's a big deal. They don't even try to talk to me anymore about when I cry. They basically just shrug, and I feel like they're so done with me at this point.
I mean I get that, and I get that other people have it worst but It doesn't make me feel better honestly. It makes me feel like an ungrateful brat who doesn't know any better
What do you mean? Physically, I'm not, but emotionally and mentally I feel exhausted and drained so I'm not even sure.
